scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Damn, if only I had
a little more money
to buy some medicine.
I should have stayed
home today, but...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
該死，要是能多賺點錢買些藥就好了。
今天本該待在家裡的，但是...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Ugh, there's nothing
worse than working when
you're supposed to be resting.
H-hey! Um, what are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
唉，明明該休息的時候卻還要工作，真是糟透了。
嘿...那個，你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Q-quit looking at
my test results right
this inst--oh. Wait.
You're not one of the
researchers here. Huh.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
別...別盯著我的實驗結果看，現在...哦。
等等。
你不是這裡的研究員吧。嗯。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Uh... Don't you have
anything better to do
than to breathe down my
back? I'm trying to finish
something here! Oh, never
mind, I'm just cranky...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
呃...你就不能做點更有意義的事，而不是在我背後盯著嗎？
我正忙著完成一些東西呢！
算了，別在意，我只是心情不好...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
You again? You don't seem
to be doing any research here.
Is there something you need?
Though, I'm afraid I can't be
of very much help to you.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
又是你？
你看起來不像是來做研究的。
有什麼事需要幫忙嗎？
不過，恐怕我幫不上什麼大忙。

scripts.text: What are you working on?
scripts.translation: 你在研究什麼？

scripts.text: I don't need anything, thanks.
scripts.translation: 我沒什麼事，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Well, I'm not sure if I can
give you all of the details.
You see, everyone here is
a researcher that can't afford
to rent a lab for himself. So we all ended up sharing this one.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
嗯，我不確定能不能告訴你所有細節。
你看，這裡的人都是租不起獨立實驗室的研究員。
所以我們只好共用這一個。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Even though we all pitched
in to rent this lab, we're all
getting pretty desperate. In
fact, a few of us have even
stolen work from each other.
That's pretty pathetic, huh?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
雖然大家一起分攤租金租了這個實驗室，但大家現在都很窘迫。
事實上，我們中有些人甚至互相偷竊對方的工作成果。
這真是挺可悲的，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
I guess that's what happens
when you're poor and don't
have a day job. Things are
so bad right now, I can't even
afford to get new materials!
What can I possibly do?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
我想這就是貧窮且沒有固定工作時的下場吧。
現在情況很糟糕，我甚至買不起新的材料！
我還能怎麼辦呢？

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Ah, I've got it! You're
an adventurer, right?
If you're still curious about
my research, I'll tell you more
about it if you help me out by
gathering some supplies for me.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
啊，我想到了！
你是冒險者，對吧？
如果你對我的研究還感興趣，只要你幫我收集一些材料，我就告訴你更多細節。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
I guess it couldn't do
much harm if you knew what
I was working on, anyway.
I mean, we'd have to be working
on the same project for you to
benefit. So, what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
我想，讓你知道我在研究什麼應該也沒什麼壞處。
畢竟，只有我們在做同一個專案，你才能從中受益。那麼，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am called {1}.

[Pisruik]
Ah, {0}.
Would you please bring
^6600005 Yellow Gemstones^000000,
^6600004 Empty Potion Bottles^000000,
^66000010 Hearts of Mermaids^000000,

[Pisruik]
If you came here to buy
Potion Manuals or something
like that, you've come to the
wrong guy. Everything you see
here is for the completion
of a personal project.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
如果你是來買藥水手冊或類似東西的，那你找錯人了。
這裡看到的一切都是為了完成個人專案。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Great you're back!
Let's see, you were
supposed to bring me
4 Empty Potion Bottles...
And... And... What else
did I ask you to get?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
太好了，你回來了！
讓我想想，你本來應該給我帶4個空藥瓶...
還有...還有...我還讓你帶什麼來著？

scripts.text: 5 Yellow Gemstones
scripts.translation: 5個黃色魔力礦石

scripts.text: 5 Blue Gemstones
scripts.translation: 5個藍色魔力礦石

scripts.text: 5 Red Gemstones
scripts.translation: 5個紅色魔力礦石

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Right, right!
5 Yellow Gemstones.
That's what I needed.
I'm sure there was more,
but what I can't recall exactly...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
對，對！
5個黃色魔力礦石。
那就是我需要的。
我確定還有別的，但我記不清具體是什麼了...

scripts.text: 10 Hearts of Mermaid
scripts.translation: 10個美人魚之心

scripts.text: 10 Large Jellopies
scripts.translation: 10個巨大傑勒比結晶

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Of course!
10 Hearts of Mermaid!
How could I forget that?
And then, the last thing
I asked you for was, um...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
當然！
10個美人魚之心！
我怎麼會忘記呢？
然後，最後一樣東西我讓你帶的是，嗯...

scripts.text: 10 Frill
scripts.translation: 10個傘蜥頸褶

scripts.text: 10 Moth Dust
scripts.translation: 10個蛾蝶翅膀粉末

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
No, that can't have
been it. I already have
plenty of Frills. Hmmm...
What am I missing now?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
不，不可能是那個。
我已經有足夠的傘蜥頸褶了。
嗯...
我現在還缺什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Right. I was just
about to say that.
So did you remember
to bring me everything?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
對了。我正要說到這個。
所以，你記得把東西都帶給我了嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 帶了！

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
You didn't...?
Oh, just admit it.
You don't want to
do this for me, right?
Don't go wasting your
time just for my sake.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
你沒帶...？
哦，直接承認吧。
你不想幫我，對吧？
別為了我浪費你的時間。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Not yet, huh?
Though I hope you can
bring me that stuff as
soon as possible, you
don't have to do it, you
know. Yeah, no big deal.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
還沒準備好，是嗎？
雖然我希望你能儘快把那些東西帶給我，但你不必勉強自己，你知道的。是的，沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Really now?
Well, let me check
what you brought to
make sure you didn't
forget anything. Hm...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
真的嗎？
好吧，讓我檢查一下你帶了什麼，確保你沒忘帶東西。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Great, it looks like
everything is here.
Alright, let me take
those. Now, guess what
I'll be making with the
materials you've brought.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
太好了，看起來東西都齊了。
好的，讓我收下這些。
現在，猜猜我要用你帶來的材料做什麼。

scripts.text: Medicine?
scripts.translation: 藥水？

scripts.text: Bomb?
scripts.translation: 炸彈？

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Hahahah, that's right!
I'm working on making
a new form of medicine.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
哈哈，沒錯！
我正在研發一種新型藥水。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
A bomb? Do I look like
a nutcase to you? No, no...
I'm developing a new form of
medicine. Sure, bombs make
good money, but where would
I test them? Here? No way!
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
炸彈？我看起來像個瘋子嗎？不，不...
我在研發一種新型藥水。
當然，炸彈很賺錢，但我哪裡去測試？這裡？
絕對不行！

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Anyway, this medicine
reacts with the human body's
digestive enzymes to initiate
temporary metabolic changes
that artificially stop heat
absorption into the body.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
總之，這種藥水會與人體消化酶反應，引發暫時的代謝變化，從而人工阻止身體吸收熱量。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
The actual effect of this
medicine is that it greatly
increases the body's resistance
to most forms of heat! However,
it will also reduce resistance
to cold as a side effect.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
這種藥水的實際效果是極大地提高身體對大多數熱量的抵抗力！
然而，副作用是會降低對寒冷的抵抗力。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
I know my medicine sounds
a little weird, but think of
the applications! If used in
the right situations, this
medicine may be quite handy.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
我知道我的藥水聽起來有點奇怪，但想想它的應用吧！
如果在合適的情況下使用，這種藥水可能會非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Ah, seeing as you're still
here, would you mind helping
me again? I need about, hmm,
20 Maneater Blossoms. If you
could bring them to me, it'd
really help me out a lot.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
啊，既然你還在這裡，介意再幫我一次嗎？
我需要大約，嗯，20個噬人樹花。
如果你能帶給我，那真的幫了我大忙。

scripts.text: Nope, I'm too busy!
scripts.translation: 不，我太忙了！

scripts.text: Sure, I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 當然，我會幫你

scripts.text: What's in it for me?
scripts.translation: 我能得到什麼好處？

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
I guess I'll have to gather
those on my own. Alright, well,
seeing as we've both gotten
what we wanted, I'll suppose
your business with me is done.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
看來我得自己去收集了。好吧，既然我們都得到了想要的東西，那我們的交易就到此為止吧。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Thanks, I really
appreciate it. While
I'm waiting for you,
I can start boiling
the Clover extract.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
謝謝，真的非常感謝。在你回來的這段時間裡，我可以先開始熬製三葉草提取物。

scripts.text: Clover extract? What's that for?
scripts.translation: 三葉草提取物？那是用來做什麼的？

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Well, I need the Clover
extract for a compound
that I'm going to make with
the Maneater Blossoms. I'm
kind of weak, so I try not to
travel too far when I can.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
嗯，我需要三葉草提取物來製作一種藥劑，我會把它和噬人樹花一起使用。我身體比較虛弱，所以儘量不去太遠的地方。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Yeah, ever since I was
little, I've had a weak
heart and bad eyesight.
The doctor tells me to avoid
stress and hard work, but
researching is my life.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
是的，從小我就心臟不好，視力也很差。醫生讓我避免壓力和繁重的工作，但研究就是我的生命。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
I wonder...
If you understand
the way I feel, how
much I've had to sacrifice
for my dream. Heh, anyway...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
我在想...
如果你能理解我的感受，理解我為夢想所做出的犧牲。
呵呵，總之...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
I hope you understand that
it's too dangerous for me to
gather Maneater Blossoms on
my own, so if I'm going to get
as much help as I can. Thanks
again for being cooperative.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
希望你能理解，我自己去收集噬人樹花太危險了，所以我能得到的幫助越多越好。再次感謝你的配合。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Ha ha ha ha!
That's real business
like of you! Alright,
I may be poor, but if
you help me, I'll give you
the results of my research.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
哈哈哈哈哈！
你真是很懂做生意啊！好吧，雖然我可能很窮，但如果你幫我，我會把研究結果給你。

scripts.text: Nah, I'm too busy.
scripts.translation: 不，我太忙了

scripts.text: Alright, I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我會幫你的

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
I guess I'll have to gather
those on my own. Alright, well,
seeing as we've both gotten
what we wanted, I'll suppose
your business with me is done.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
看來我得自己去收集了。好吧，既然我們都得到了想要的東西，那我們的交易就到此為止吧。

I hope you understand that
it's too dangerous for me to
gather Maneater Blossoms on
my own, so if I'm going to get
as much help as I can. Thanks
again for being cooperative.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
希望你能理解，我自己去收集噬人樹花太危險了，所以我能得到的幫助越多越好。再次感謝你的配合。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
So you knew what
you had to bring, came
to remind me what I had
forgotten, but didn't bring
anything? Weird. Ah well.
Come with the stuff next time.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
所以你知道該帶什麼，來提醒我忘了什麼，但什麼都沒帶？真奇怪。算了。
下次把東西帶來吧。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Oh, this isn't good, some
of the items I asked for are
missing. I'm sorry, but Alchemy
gets dangerously unpredictable
when things aren't used in just
the right amounts. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
哦，這不好，我要求的一些材料缺失了。抱歉，但如果材料用量不準確，鍊金術會變得非常不可預測。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Well, I can afford to
push my deadlines back
if you promise to return
with the materials I need
as soon as you possibly can.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
好吧，如果你承諾儘快帶著我需要的材料回來，我可以推遲我的截止日期。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Large Jellopy?
Yes, Large--no.
Wait, that doesn't
sound right at all.
No, it was something
else I need you to get.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
巨大傑勒比結晶？
是的，巨大--不。
等等，這聽起來完全不對。
不，我需要你帶的是別的東西。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Blue Gemstones...?
No, that was for the
potion that increases
tolerance to the Water
property, I think. What's
wrong with my memory?!
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
藍色魔力礦石...？
不，那是用來製作提高水屬性耐性的藥劑的，我想。我的記憶出什麼問題了？！

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Red Gemstones...?
No, that was for the
potion that increases
tolerance to the Earth
property, I think. What's
wrong with my memory?!
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
紅色魔力礦石...？
不，那是用來製作提高土屬性耐性的藥劑的，我想。我的記憶出什麼問題了？！

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Why did you just leave?
You didn't even let me
finish talking! Oh well,
maybe it's not your fault.
Anyway, just so you know,
I'm developing a new medicine.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
你剛才為什麼走了？
你甚至沒讓我把話說完！算了，也許不是你的錯。總之，告訴你一聲，我正在研發一種新藥。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Alright, did you
want to learn more
about the medicine that
I'm developing? I mean,
that's why you came, right?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
好吧，你想了解更多關於我正在研發的藥水的資訊嗎？我是說，你來的目的就是這個，對吧？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Alright then.
Really? Well, I'm
willing to spend the
time to explain it to
you. After all, you did
help me out just then.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
好的。
真的嗎？好吧，我願意花時間向你解釋。畢竟，你剛才幫了我大忙。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
I'm working on a new
form of medicine that,
hopefully, will be used
for the betterment and
protection of mankind!
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
我正在研發一種新型藥劑，希望能用於人類的福祉與保護！

嗯，如果你改變主意了，隨時歡迎回來讓我教你。

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, there
is nothing in your inventory
that seems like a suitable
replacement for Pisruik's
broken glasses.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF很遺憾，你的物品欄裡似乎沒有合適的東西可以替換皮斯魯伊克的眼鏡。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Listen, you look so
much better when you're
not wearing glasses.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
聽我說，你不戴眼鏡的時候看起來好多了。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Excuse me,
come again?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
抱歉，請再說一遍？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hahahahhaha~!
No-nothing at all!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈哈哈哈~！
沒、沒什麼！

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
So, {0},
Would you like me to
teach you the results
of the research I've''
been conducting?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
那麼，{0}，你想讓我教你我最近研究的結果嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 帶了！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Great, {0}!
I know I can trust you
to use this research for
good and noble ends. Now,
please read this thesis and
all of my additional notes...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
太好了，{0}！
我相信你會把這項研究用於高尚的目的。那麼，請閱讀這篇論文以及我的所有補充筆記...

scripts.text:
^3355FFPisruik thoroughly
explains the properties
of his medicine, the reaction
of the human organs to it, as
well as a few warnings about
the medicine's side effects.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF皮斯魯伊克詳細解釋了他的藥劑的特性，人體器官對其的反應，以及關於該藥劑副作用的一些警告。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Well, you should be
ready to make your own
potions that are a variation
of my medicine. But you'll
probably need to keep that
thesis as a ready reference.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
好了，你應該準備好製作我的藥劑的變體了。
但你可能還是需要隨時參考那篇論文。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Hopefully, we'll
meet again sometime
in the future. Good luck on
your journeys, adventurer.
*Cough cough* Now... What
will be my next project?
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
希望我們將來還能再見面。祝你在旅途中好運，冒險者。
*咳嗽咳嗽* 那麼...
我的下一個專案會是什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Anyway, I need to be
working on a new project
soon, so I suppose this is
where we part ways for now.
But I must say, it was truly
a great pleasure to meet you...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
總之，我很快就需要開始一個新專案了，所以我想我們現在就在此分別吧。
但不得不說，認識你真的是一種榮幸...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
R-Really...?
Well, if you ever change
your mind, feel free to come
back for me to teach you.
And it's no trouble at all!
I really enjoy your company...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
真...真的嗎？
嗯，如果你改變主意了，隨時歡迎回來讓我教你。
完全不用客氣！
我真的很享受和你在一起...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
R-Really...?
Well, if you ever change
your mind, feel free to come
back for me to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
真...真的嗎？
嗯，如果你改變主意了，隨時歡迎回來讓我教你。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Uh oh...
You lost the thesis
I wrote for you? I don't
have the time to write
another one for you now...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
哎呀...
你把我寫給你的論文弄丟了？
我現在沒時間再給你寫一篇了...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
So, how have you been
using the potions that
I've taught you to make?
Hopefully, they'll come
in handy in your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
那麼，你使用我教你的藥劑的情況如何？
希望它們能在你的冒險中派上用場。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Huh, so copies of my
thesis are circulating
around in public? Well,
I'm sorry, but I don't have
time to autograph your copy...
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
咦，我的論文竟然在市面上流傳？
抱歉，但我沒時間給你簽名...

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Mmm...?
Did you need anything
in particular? Though,
I'm afraid someone in
my position won't be
much help to you.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
嗯...？
你有什麼特別的需求嗎？
不過，恐怕像我這樣身份的人幫不上你什麼忙。

scripts.text:
[Pisruik]
Mmm...?
Did you need anything
in particular? Though,
I'm afraid someone in
my position won't be
much help to you.
scripts.translation:
[皮斯魯伊克]
嗯...？
你有什麼特別的需求嗎？
不過，恐怕像我這樣身份的人幫不上你什麼忙。

scripts.text:
[Irache]
Heh heh heh...!
It's done! With this
formula, I can melt any
substance in the world!
Hahahaha! Nothing stands
between me and world domi--
scripts.translation:
[伊拉切]
嘿嘿嘿...！
完成了！有了這個配方，我可以融化世界上任何物質！
哈哈哈！沒有什麼能阻擋我統治世界——

scripts.text:
[Irache]
OWWWW!
The secret formula!
It's burning through
the test tube! I've made
it too powerful! Confound it!
scripts.translation:
[伊拉切]
哇啊啊啊！
秘密配方！
它燒穿了試管！
我做得太強力了！該死！

scripts.text:
[Degas]
It's such a pain working
so close to these other
scientists. The guy next
time is always cackling
about taking over the
world and whatnot.
scripts.translation:
[德加]
和這些科學家靠得太近工作真麻煩。
隔壁的傢伙總是咯咯笑著說要統治世界之類的。

scripts.text:
[Degas]
And this other geek is
always coughing. Between
the two of them, it's far too
noisy to focus on my research!
If only I could work in my very own private, secret laboratory...
scripts.translation:
[德加]
還有那個書呆子總是咳嗽。這兩個人加在一起，吵得我根本無法專心研究！
要是能有一個屬於我自己的秘密實驗室就好了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's simply a pile
of scattered documents.
Although it seems unorganized,
it doesn't look like the people
here have any trouble finding^FFFFFF ^3355FF what they need when they need it.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這只是一堆散亂的文件。
雖然看起來雜亂無章，但這裡的人似乎總能在需要時找到^FFFFFF ^3355FF他們需要的東西。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Keep up the
good work. I get
the feeling that
our future might
be depending on you...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
繼續加油。
我有一種感覺，我們的未來可能正取決於你...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Alright then, I'll begin
by teaching you ^FF0000Bioethics^000000,
the fundamental skill for
creating Homunculi.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
那麼，我先教你^FF0000生命倫理^000000，這是創造生命體的基礎技能。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
In order to master Bioethics,
you've got to appreciate the
sweetness of life and genuinely
care about living creatures.
And so, you must always take
care of your Homunculus.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
為了掌握生命倫理，你必須珍視生命的甜美，並真心關愛生物。
因此，你必須始終照顧好你的生命體。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
You must constantly check
to see if your Homunculus
is tired or hungry, or if it's
been hurt. You must also take
into account your Homunculus's feelings towards you, its owner.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
你必須時刻檢查你的生命體是否疲憊或飢餓，或者是否受傷。你還需要考慮你的生命體對主人——也就是你——的感受。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
When that nurturing attitude
becomes second nature to you,
you will have mastered Bioethics. It sounds simple, but you can only
understand a relationship with a Homunculus through experience.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
當這種關懷的態度成為你的本能時，你就掌握了生命倫理。這聽起來很簡單，但你只能通過經驗來理解與生命體的關係。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Well, you should know enough
by now to create and care for
your own Homunculus. I trust
that you will be responsible
in your search for discoveries
that may benefit mankind.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
好吧，你應該已經知道如何創造和照顧你自己的生命體了。我相信你在尋找可能造福人類的發現時，會負起責任。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Before we part
ways, would you
tell me your name?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
在我們分別之前，能告訴我你的名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is...
{1}.

[Kellasus]
Ah...
{0}.
I'll remember that. Goodbye
for now, and I hope that you
make a great contribution to
the world of Alchemy someday.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
啊...
{0}。
我會記住的。
暫時別了，希望有一天你能為鍊金術的世界做出偉大的貢獻。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Our viewpoints may be
different, but I'll agree that
there's too much potential in
studying Homunculi that I can
no longer ignore as a scientist
and as a humanitarian.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我們的觀點可能不同，但我同意，研究生命體的潛力太大，作為科學家和人道主義者，我都無法再忽視它。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
If I teach you these skills,
you may be treading a moral
line. But I believe it should
be alright if you work to learn
something that will benefit
the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
如果我教你這些技能，你可能正在觸碰道德的底線。
但我相信，如果你致力於學習能造福大眾的知識，那應該沒問題。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Does...
Does that mean
you'll teach me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那...那意思是你要教我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Now don't get too excited.
I'm still unsure if Homunculus
Study should be open to all
Alchemists, but for now,
I believe I can trust you.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
先別太激動。
我還在猶豫是否應該向所有鍊金術士公開生命體研究，但就目前而言，我相信可以信任你。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
However, you've got to
use the skills I teach you
to ultimately benefit other
people. It's not like I can force you to forget once you know how
to make Homunculi, understand?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
不過，你必須利用我教你的技能最終造福他人。
畢竟，一旦你知道了如何製造生命體，我就沒法強迫你忘記了，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Please give me a little
time to prepare my lesson
for you. It's been a very long
time since I've done this...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
請給我一點時間來準備給你的課程。
我已經很久沒有做過這件事了...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
I'm so confused...
There's no denying that
everything you said is right.
But now I don't know what
I should believe...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
我很困惑...
不可否認，你說的都是對的。
但現在我不知道該相信什麼...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Have you come to
ask me again to teach
you Homunculus skills?
You're awfully persistent,
but I suppose that might be
how you became an Alchemist...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
你是來再次請求我教你生命體技能的嗎？
你還真是執著，不過我想，也許這就是你成為鍊金術士的原因...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I sort of came
here to ask about that.
But first, I heard a rumor
that your son was really
sick for a while...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我確實是想來問問這件事。
但首先，我聽說你的兒子之前病得很重...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Y-yes. It's really
difficult for me to
talk about that time.
The thought of losing
my boy is too much to bear.
He means the world to me...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
是...是的。那段時光對我來說很難開口。
想到失去我的男孩，那種痛苦難以承受。
他對我來說就是全世界...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I was so desperate to
keep my boy alive that
I would have sold my soul
without any regret. I'm more
than willing to sacrifice my
own life for his sake.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
為了保住我兒子的命，我甚至願意出賣靈魂，毫無悔意。為了他，我甚至願意犧牲自己的生命。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Luckily, my son
recovered from his
disease and he is very
healthy nowadays. But
why are you reminding
me of something like this?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
幸運的是，我的兒子從疾病中康復了，現在非常健康。
但你為什麼要提起這種事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're right that the creation
of Homunculi brings up a moral
issue. But instead of morals,
I want to appeal to your sense
of humanitarianism if I can.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你說得對，創造生命體確實涉及道德問題。
但比起道德，如果可以的話，我更想訴諸你的人道主義精神。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I don't follow.
What exactly
do you mean by
humanitarianism?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我不明白。
你說的人道主義具體是指什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I believe that the
study of Homunculi
could help us discover
the secret of life. There
is just too much
potential to do good to ignore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我相信，研究生命體能幫助我們發現生命的秘密。
其中蘊含的造福他人的潛力太大，不能忽視。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not interested in
creating new creatures or
playing God. What I do want
is the knowledge to cure people
regardless of the disease. No
matter how desperate it may be.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我對創造新生物或扮演上帝不感興趣。
我想要的是無論疾病多麼絕望，都能治癒人們的知識。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It may be immoral to
create experimental life
forms and to sacrifice them,
but I'm willing to do that for
the people who may need
that cure I might discover...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
創造實驗性生命形式並犧牲它們可能不道德，但為了那些可能需要我可能發現的解藥的人，我願意這麼做...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
When your son was
sick, you were willing
to make sacrifices to see
that he recover. But still,
there are other people in the
world with worse ailments...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當你的兒子生病時，你願意做出犧牲只為讓他康復。
但世界上還有其他人患著更嚴重的疾病...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want to study
Homunculi because
there's a chance that
I might be able to bring
hope to someone's
hopeless situation...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想研究生命體，是因為有機會能為那些陷入絕望境地的人帶來希望...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I've never...
I never thought...
I'm sorry. I need
some time alone...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我從未...
我從未想過...
抱歉。我需要獨處一會兒...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Although I admit that
you're capabile of learning
what I might be able to teach
you about Homunculi, I can't
in good conscience do it. I'm
sorry, but please give up.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
雖然我承認你有能力學會我可能教你的關於生命體的知識，但我無法良心安寧地這樣做。
抱歉，請放棄吧。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
How many times must I tell
you? I'm sorry, but I can't teach you anything related to Homunculi.
It especially bothers me that you know nothing at all about them...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我要告訴你多少次？
抱歉，但我不能教你任何與生命體有關的東西。
特別是你對此一無所知，這讓我很困擾...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But while I was gone,
I spent so much time
studying about Homunculi
from these Alchemy experts.
I guarantee that I'm qualified
to learn the fundamentals!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但在我離開的這段時間裡，我花了大量時間向這些鍊金術專家學習關於生命體的知識。
我保證我有資格學習基礎知識！

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Experts...? Ah, you mean
Skrajjad, Keshibien and
Broncher. My old colleages.
Alright. But I'll be the judge
of whether or not you learned
anything about Homunculi.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
專家...？啊，你是說斯克拉賈德、科希比恩和布朗徹。我的老同事。
好吧。但我會判斷你是否真的學到了關於生命體的東西。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I'm going to give you
several questions, so
I hope you answer all
of these correctly.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我要問你幾個問題，希望你能全部答對。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
First question.
What skill, mastered
at Skill Level 1, allows
the caster to retreat a
Homunculus, putting it in
an inert state of hibernation?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
第一個問題。
在技能等級1時掌握的技能，允許施法者收回生命體，使其進入休眠狀態的是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Hmm, not bad. So you've
been studying. Now, the second
question. What is the item, whose name indicates a very early stage
of Homunculus development, used for the Call Homunculus skill?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
嗯，不錯。看來你確實學習過。那麼，第二個問題。用於“生命體召喚”技能的物品，其名稱表明生命體發育的極早期階段，是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Huh. You got that one
right too. Alright, third
question. What is the
name of the skill, mastered
at Skill Level 5, which allows
you to resurrect Homunculi?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
哈。這一題你也答對了。好的，第三個問題。在技能等級5時掌握的技能，允許你復活生命體，它的名字是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
So you have been putting
a lot of effort in studying
this. I really admire your
dedication and it looks like
you've got the potential to
be a really great Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
看來你確實付出了很多努力來學習這個。我真的很佩服你的專注，看起來你有潛力成為一名非常優秀的鍊金術士。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Still, even though you're
qualified to learn all the
Homunculus skills, I choose
not to teach them based on
my own personal principles.
Nothing can change my mind.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
儘管如此，即使你有資格學習所有生命體技能，我基於自己的原則選擇不教你。
什麼都改變不了我的想法。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I admit that I'm proud
of the progress you've
made, but I just can't
bring myself to be a part
of what I believe to be an
abuse of the gift of life.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我承認我為你的進步感到自豪，但我就是無法讓自己成為我認為的對生命之禮的濫用的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
There's just so much
risk! I don't think I can
bear to be responsible for
any of the consequences that
may come with the existence
of artificially created life.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
風險太大了！我認為我無法承受人工創造的生命存在所帶來的任何後果的責任。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I'm disappointed...
I really thought you
had learned everything
you could about Homunculi,
but it looks like there are a
few gaps in your knowledge.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我很失望...
我真的以為你已經學到了關於生命體的一切，但看起來你的知識還有一些漏洞。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Hmm... It looks like
you still haven't learned
enough about Homunculi.
Even if I wanted to teach
you, it looks like you're
not quite ready to learn...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
嗯...看起來你還沒有學到足夠的關於生命體的知識。
即使我想教你，看起來你還沒準備好學習...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
You'd be able to get
the first question right
if you were really serious
about studying Homunculi.
You'd better just give up and
find a new alchemic interest.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
如果你真的認真想學習生命體，你應該能答對第一個問題。
你最好放棄，尋找新的鍊金術興趣。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I'm sorry, but
I refuse to teach
you anything related
to the Homunculus skills.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
抱歉，但我拒絕教你任何與生命體技能有關的東西。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I should feel insulted that
you asked me, but once there
was a time when I was more
like you, so I can understand
how you feel. However, my
views are much different now...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
你這樣問我，我本該感到被冒犯，但曾經有一段時間我更像你，所以我能理解你的感受。然而，我現在的觀點大不相同...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Oh, hello, what
brings you this way?
As your senior in the
field of Alchemy, I can
give you some advice if you're stumped by a particular problem...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
哦，你好，是什麼風把你吹來了？
作為鍊金術領域的前輩，如果你遇到了什麼難題，我可以給你一些建議...

scripts.text: Teach me the Homunculus Skills.
scripts.translation: 教我生命體技能

scripts.text: No, nothing.
scripts.translation: 不，沒什麼

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I want you to
teach me how to
create a Homunculus.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想讓你教我如何創造生命體。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
...
Come again?
I don't think I heard
what you said quite right.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
...
再說一遍？
我好像沒聽清你剛才說的話。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I said...
I want you to
teach me the skills
for Homunculus creation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我說...
我想讓你教我創造生命體的技能。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
After all of my talk...
My warnings about knowledge
that should be forbidden to
Alchemists, you want to go
and create a Homunculus?!
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
在我說了那麼多之後...
在我警告過你鍊金術士不該觸碰的知識之後，你竟然想去創造生命體？！

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Perhaps I never should
have mentioned that subject.
But I still don't understand why you would suddenly want to 
learn those skills. Yes, it's
true that I could teach you...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
也許我當初就不該提起那個話題。
但我還是不明白，你為什麼突然想學習那些技能。
是的，我確實可以教你...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
But I refuse to pass down
my knowledge of Homunculi
to anyone for any reason.
Surely, you must know that
by now. I'm stupefied that you
even had the audacity to ask!
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
但我拒絕將關於生命體的知識傳授給任何人，無論出於什麼理由。
到現在你應該知道了吧。
我簡直不敢相信你竟然敢開口問！

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
No? Well, I suppose
learning something on
your own is good, but
sometimes it's good to ask
for help from those who are
more experienced than you.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
不？好吧，我覺得自學是好事，但有時候向比你更有經驗的人尋求幫助也是好的。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Ah, you've returned...
Now, you must be wondering
why I have been warning you
about the dangers of using
Alchemy to obtain knowledge
that should be forbidden.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
啊，你回來了...
現在，你一定很想知道為什麼我一直警告你使用鍊金術去獲取那些禁忌知識的危險。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
It is better that you know now
than to find out later and not
be prepared. There is a skill
in Alchemy that transgresses
the natural laws by creating
life not intended by God.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
現在知道總比以後發現時措手不及要好。
鍊金術中有一項技能違背了自然法則，它創造了上帝未曾賦予的生命。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
It is an extremely
dangerous skill that was
developed out of human
arrogance. Life is a beautiful
thing, a precious gift, that
we dare not tamper with.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
這是一項極其危險的技能，它是出於人類的傲慢而發展出來的。
生命是美好的事物，是珍貴的禮物，我們不敢隨意妄為。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
My greatest shame in
life is my contribution to
that field of knowledge. At
that time I was young and
headstrong, too proud to
admit I was playing God.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我一生最大的恥辱就是我對那個領域的貢獻。
那時我還年輕，意氣用事，太驕傲了，不肯承認自己是在扮演上帝。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I even went so far as to
become the most skilled
Alchemist in the creation
of ^FF0000Homunculi^000000. But I've
changed my ways. I don't...
I'll never create one again.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我甚至成為了創造^FF0000生命體^000000最熟練的鍊金術士。
但我已經改過自新了。我不...
我再也不會創造它們了。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Alchemy is an incredible
field of study, and it's great
that you've dedicated yourself
to it, but always remember that
this science has great potential for abuse, as well as for good.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
鍊金術是一門不可思議的學科，很高興你投身其中，但請永遠記住，這門科學既有巨大的潛力用於善，也有被濫用的風險。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
I only fear that your quest
for knowledge, your insatiable
curiosity to reveal the unknown, may lead you on the path of the
Homunculus. For your own sake, don't bother considering the idea.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
我只擔心你對知識的追求，你那不知饜足的好奇心，可能會引導你走上生命體的道路。
為了你自己，別去考慮這個念頭。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Remember that all life is
precious. If your motives
are good, and untainted by
the desire for fame or fortune,
and if you work for the greater good of mankind, you'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
記住，所有的生命都是珍貴的。
如果你的動機是好的，沒有被名聲或財富的慾望所玷汙，並且你為了人類的更大利益而努力，那你就會沒事的。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Ah, it's you again.
Since you're here, let
me ask you a question.
What exactly do you
think of Alchemy?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
啊，又是你。
既然你來了，讓我問你一個問題。
你究竟怎麼看待鍊金術？

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Wait. Don't answer
that. As someone more
experienced in this field,
I believe that the answer
to that question is more
complicated than you think.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
等等。別回答。
作為一個在這個領域更有經驗的人，我相信那個問題的答案比你想像的要複雜得多。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Most people see Alchemists
as greedy scientists, assuming
that we use our skills exclusively for^FFFFFF.^000000the transmutation of gold. Of
course, learning how to do that
is part of our basic training.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
大多數人認為鍊金術士是貪婪的科學家，認為我們只利用技能進行^FFFFFF.^000000黃金的轉化。
當然，學習如何做到這一點是我們基礎訓練的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
But learning transmutation
is part of something bigger.
All Alchemists must strive to
harness nature for the good
of mankind. To do this requires
the study of every science.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
但學習轉化只是更大目標的一部分。
所有鍊金術士都必須努力利用自然之力造福人類。
為此，需要研究所有的科學。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
The fields of Medicine,
Chemistry, Biology, Geology,
Astronomy, Astrology, Geomancy,
Mathematics, Physics and even
Philosophy must all be learned
by the competent Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
醫學、化學、生物學、地質學、天文學、占星術、風水學、數學、物理學，甚至哲學，都必須被合格的鍊金術士所掌握。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Once you've entered the
exciting vastness of Alchemy,
there is no turning back. Do
your best to learn all that you
can, and never forget that you have responsibilities to mankind.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
一旦你踏入鍊金術這片廣闊而迷人的領域，就沒有回頭路了。盡你所能去學習，並永遠記住你對人類的責任。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
You're another
practitioner of
Alchemy, aren't you?
It's been a long time
since I've spoken to
such a young colleague...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
你也是一名鍊金術士，對吧？
我已經很久沒有和這麼年輕的同行交談過了...

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
As your elder colleague,
I encourage you to focus
on your training. Enlighten
yourself and satisfy your
curiosity by solving the
riddles of science.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
作為你的前輩，我鼓勵你專注於訓練。
通過解開科學的謎題來啟迪自己，滿足你的好奇心。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
But heed my words...
There are secrets of
science that must never
be discovered by humans.
Do not be so proud as to
seek out forbidden truths.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
但請聽我一句忠告...
有些科學的秘密是人類永遠不該發現的。
不要傲慢到去追尋被禁止的真理。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Good luck in your
studies, and I hope
you never use your
search for answers as
an excuse to give in to
greed and obsession.
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
祝你在研究中好運，我希望你永遠不要把尋找答案當作藉口，去屈服於貪婪和執念。

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
Hmm. Who decides what
is right and wrong? What is
meant to be known and what
secrets were never intended
for mankind to understand?
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
嗯。誰來決定什麼是對，什麼是錯？
什麼是註定要被知曉的，而哪些秘密本就不該被人類理解？

scripts.text:
[Kellasus]
There are many who would
agree that God alone wields
authority over life and death.
But Alchemy does provide
a way for the audacious...
scripts.translation:
[凱拉蘇斯]
許多人會同意，只有上帝才擁有生殺予奪的權力。
但鍊金術確實為那些大膽的人提供了一條道路...

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
I've taught you everything
I can about the Homunculi.
I hope that I've been of some
help in your quest for knowledge and understanding of our universe.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
我已經把我知道的關於生命體的一切都教給你了。
我希望我在你探索和理解我們宇宙的旅程中幫到了你。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
If you haven't already done
so, please visit Keshibien,
master of the Call Homunculus
skill. He's a kind person who's
always willing to go out of his
way to help young scientists.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
如果你還沒有的話，請去拜訪科希比恩，他是“生命體召喚”技能的導師。
他是個善良的人，總是樂於幫助年輕的科學家。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
Ah, you're the one
who had the courage
to ask Kellasus to teach
you Alchemy. I must say
that I admire your attitude,
young lad. Now, don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
啊，你就是那個有勇氣請求凱拉蘇斯教你鍊金術的人。
不得不說，我很欣賞你的態度，年輕人。現在，別擔心...

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
Ah, you're the one
who had the courage
to ask Kellasus to teach
you Alchemy. I must say
that I admire your attitude,
young lass. Now, don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
啊，你就是那個有勇氣請求凱拉蘇斯教你鍊金術的人。
不得不說，我很欣賞你的態度，年輕的女士。現在，別擔心...

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
I understand how you
must feel after Kellasus
refused to teach you his
methods, but that does not
mean that you'll never learn
how to create a Homunculus.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
我理解你在凱拉蘇斯拒絕教你他的方法後的感受，但這並不意味著你永遠學不會如何創造生命體。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
I believe you'll be able to learn what you desire if you manage to
train under all of the Homunculus experts. When you show how serious
you are about this, then Kellasus might change his mind about you.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
我相信，如果你能在所有生命體專家手下接受訓練，你就能學到你想要的東西。
當你表現出你的決心時，凱拉蘇斯可能會改變對你的看法。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
Let give teach you my
Homunculus specialty,
the ^FF0000Vaporize^000000 skill. Actually,
it's useless without Kellasus's
technique, but it should be a
good enough starting point.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
讓我教你我的生命體專長，^FF0000安息^000000技能。實際上，沒有凱拉蘇斯的技術它沒什麼用，但這應該是一個不錯的起點。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
The Vaporize skill
is an Alchemist skill
that deals solely with
Homunculi. Vaporize is
mastered at Skill Level 1.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
“安息”技能是鍊金術士的技能，專門針對生命體。
“安息”在技能等級1時即可掌握。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
This skill allows you to
reduce your Homunculus
to vapor so that it is in an
inert chemical state. It's
very similar to hibernation
when you think about it.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
這個技能允許你將你的生命體轉化為蒸汽，使其處於惰性化學狀態。仔細想想，這非常類似於冬眠。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
Now, if you want to
bring back a vaporized
Homunculus, you will need
to know the ^FF0000Call Homunculus^000000
which you can learn from
Keshibien. Just remember...
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
現在，如果你想讓一個被蒸發的生命體回來，你需要知道^FF0000生命體召喚^000000，你可以從科希比恩那裡學到它。記住...

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
Homunculi are living
creatures, so don't go
and vaporize and recall
them recklessly. That sort
of behavior would be inhumane.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
生命體是有生命的生物，所以不要隨意地將它們蒸發又召回。
這種行為是不人道的。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
''Show respect for all life
forms.'' That's the creed
for the Homuculus expert.
Now go and find ^FF0000Keshibien^000000
so that he can teach you
the Call Homunculus skill.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
“尊重所有生命形式。”
這是生命體專家的信條。
現在去找^FF0000科希比恩^000000，讓他教你“生命體召喚”技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
Good luck in
your studies
and I hope you
find the answers
that you are seeking.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
祝你的學習順利，希望你能找到你所追尋的答案。

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
Alchemy is wondrous...
It incorporates every
science and many other
fields of knowledge that
it's not enough to be jack
of all trades... No...
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
鍊金術是奇妙的...
它融合了所有科學以及許多其他知識領域，僅僅樣樣通是不夠的...
不...

scripts.text:
[Skrajjad]
In a sense, you must
be a master of all trades
to be proficient in Alchemy.
But it's incredibly rewarding to those of us who never stop asking
how and why our world works.
scripts.translation:
[斯克拉賈德]
從某種意義上說，你必須樣樣精通才能精通鍊金術。
但對於那些從未停止追問世界為何如此運作的人來說，這是極其有回報的。

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
I hope that you
can make good use
of what I've taught you.
I'm glad that I was able
to contribute something to
your learning of Alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
我希望你能好好利用我教你的東西。
很高興我能為你學習鍊金術貢獻一點力量。

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
Now, the only person qualified
to teach you the Homunculus
Resurrection skill is Brocher.
He's... He's a character, but
he's also a great teacher.
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
現在，唯一有資格教你“復活生命體”技能的人是布羅徹。
他...他是個怪人，但也是個很棒的老師。

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
Now...
Where could he be?
I know he likes to drink,
so maybe you can find him
some place where they serve
alcohol in Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
現在...
他會在哪裡呢？
我知道他喜歡喝酒，所以也許你可以在裡希塔樂鎮找一家提供酒精飲料的地方看看？

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
Oh! You must be the
one Skrajjad told me
about. So you've come
so I can teach you the
Call Homunculus skill?
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
哦！你一定是斯克拉賈德跟我提過的那個人。
所以你是來讓我教你“生命體召喚”技能的？

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
First of all, it's always
a pleasure to meet another
colleague. I'm Keshibien, and
although I'm an expert on this
particular skill, overall I'm just a run of the mill Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
首先，很高興能遇到另一位同行。
我是科希比恩，雖然我是這個特定技能的專家，但總體來說，我只是一個普通的鍊金術士。

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
Anyway, the Call Homunculus
skill requires knowledge of the
Vaporize skill and is mastered
at Skill Level 1. This skill allows you to summon a Homunculus.
Pretty simple so far, right?
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
總之，“生命體召喚”技能需要掌握“安息”技能，在技能等級1時即可掌握。
這個技能允許你召喚生命體。
到目前為止很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
Now, you can summon a
vaporized Homunculus if
you happen to have one.
Otherwise, you can just
create one through using
this skill and these items...
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
現在，如果你碰巧有一個被蒸發的生命體，你可以召喚它。
否則，你可以使用這個技能和這些物品來創造一個...

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
^FF00001 Embryo^000000,
^FF00001 Glass Tube^000000,
^FF00001 Seed of Life^000000 and
^FF00001 Morning Dew of Yggdrasil^000000.

[Keshibien]
Well, that's all the
technical information
I have to share with you.
Always remember to treat
your Homunculus well. Eh,
once you summon one, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
好了，這就是我要告訴你的所有技術資訊。
永遠記得善待你的生命體。
呃，一旦你召喚了一個的話。

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
But before you can do
that, you need to learn
the techniques that only
Kellasus can teach you.
For now, go to ^FF0000Broncher^000000
and learn from him, okay?
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
但在你做到這一點之前，你需要學習只有凱拉蘇斯才能教你的技巧。
現在，去找^FF0000布朗徹^000000並向他學習，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
Broncher happens
to specialize in the
Homunculus Resurrection
skill. You should be able to
find him somewhere in town,
though I'm unsure where...
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
布朗徹恰好專精於“復活生命體”技能。
你應該能在鎮上找到他，雖然我不確定他在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
Anyway, it was really
nice to meet you. Hopefully,
you'll be able to learn how
to fully use a Homunculus
someday soon. Still, you'll
need to convince Kellasus...
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
總之，很高興見到你。
希望不久之後，你能學會如何完全使用生命體。
不過，你還需要說服凱拉蘇斯...

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
Hello there~
You must be from
Rune-Midgarts, right?
It's nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
你好~
你一定是從盧恩·米德加茲來的，對吧？
很高興見到你。

scripts.text:
[Keshibien]
I hear that the
Alchemists from
over there are pretty
skilled. I wonder if I'll
ever get the chance to
collaborate with any of them...
scripts.translation:
[科希比恩]
我聽說那邊的鍊金術士技術相當不錯。
不知道我有沒有機會和他們中的任何一個合作...

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
You again? Didn't I already
teach you the Homunculus
Resurrection skill? Come
on, there's nothing else
I can do for you. Lemme
enjoy myself here...
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
又是你？我不是已經教過你“復活生命體”技能了嗎？
拜託，我沒什麼能幫你的了。
讓我在這裡盡興一下...

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
If you didn't already,
go and bother Kellasus
and get him to teach you the
basic Homunculus techniques.
Now go away, you're sobering
me up! Go on, get outta here!
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
如果你還沒去的話，去找凱拉蘇斯，讓他教你生命體的基礎技術。
現在滾開，你讓我清醒了！
快走吧，別在這礙事！

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
^333333*Hiccup!*^000000
Oh man...
Oh man, this stuff
is great! Yeah. Yeah,
this really hits the spot.
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
^333333*嗝~*^000000
天哪...
天哪，這酒真不錯！
對，對，這感覺太棒了。

scripts.text:
[Brocher]
Holy crap! Y-you're that
Alchemist that Skrajjad
told me to expect! Wha--?
You already visited Keshibien?
Crap! I thought you wouldn't
get here for another... Hour!
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
天哪！你...你就是斯克拉賈德讓我等著的那個鍊金術士嗎？什...？
你已經見過科希比恩了？
該死！我還以為你至少還要...一個小時才能到！

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
Oh, forget sobering.
I'll just teach you the
^FF0000Homunculus Resurrection^000000
skill. It's one of the last
skills you need to learn
for Homunculi, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
哦，算了，不讓你清醒了。
我就教你^FF0000復活生命體^000000技能吧。反正這也是你為了使用生命體必須學會的最後一個技能。

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
Yes, you can literally
bring Homunculi back
from the dead. Oh, and you
should know that this skill is
mastered at Skill Level 5.
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
沒錯，你可以讓生命體起死回生。哦，還有，你應該知道這個技能在技能等級5時達到精通。

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
To bring your
Homunculus back from
the dead, you just push
this button, the one that's
labeled, ''Homunculus
Resurrection.'' Easy, right?
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
要讓生命體起死回生，你只需要按下這個按鈕，就是那個標著“復活生命體”的按鈕。很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
Well, lesson's over.
You know everything you
need to know about using
Homunculus Resurrection.
But you still need Kellasus
to teach you the fundamentals.
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
好了，課結束了。
關於如何使用復活生命體，你已經知道你需要知道的一切了。
但你還是需要凱拉蘇斯來教你基礎。

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
Without those basic
techiques, everything
you've studied from us
will be for nothing. So...
Lots of luck convincing
Kellasus to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
沒有那些基礎技術，你從我們這裡學到的一切都將毫無意義。所以...
祝你好運，去說服凱拉蘇斯教你吧。

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
Now leave alone
and let me enjoy
all of this alcohol
in solitude, alright?
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
現在讓我一個人待著，讓我獨自享受這些美酒，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Broncher]
^333333*Hiccup~*^000000
Oh yeah, this is
the stuff! I call it...
My ''Anti-Sobriety''
formula! Can't think
of a finer thing created...
scripts.translation:
[布朗徹]
^333333*嗝~*^000000
哦耶，這才是好東西！我稱之為...
我的“防清醒”配方！想不出比這更棒的東西了...

scripts.text:
[Koring]
My daddy is the bestest
Alchemist! He's sooooo
smart, and I never heard
him be wrong before!
scripts.translation:
[科林]
爸爸是最棒的鍊金術士！
他超級聰明，我以前從沒聽他說過錯話！

scripts.text:
[Koring]
Daddy's been thinking
a lot lately and I don't
know why. Daddy gets 
really serious when he's 
worried about something.
scripts.translation:
[科林]
爸爸最近一直在思考，我不知道為什麼。爸爸在擔心某件事的時候會變得非常嚴肅。

scripts.text:
[Koring]
He's always trying hard
to make me happy and to 
help me when I have problems.
Like the time I was really sick...
scripts.translation:
[科林]
他總是努力讓我開心，在我遇到問題時幫助我。
就像我生病那次...

scripts.text:
[Koring]
Daddy did his best to make
some medicine to help me, 
and he looked all over for any
doctor who could cure me. For
a while, I was really scared,
but my Daddy never gave up.
scripts.translation:
[科林]
爸爸盡力為我製作藥物來幫助我，他到處尋找能治好我的醫生。有一段時間，我非常害怕，但爸爸從未放棄。

scripts.text:
[Koring]
He might be a little
grumpy now, but my 
Daddy is still the best!
I hope he feels better soon.
scripts.translation:
[科林]
他現在可能有點脾氣不好，但我的爸爸仍然是最棒的！
我希望他快點好起來。

scripts.text:
[Koring]
How did my Daddy get
so smart? I wish I could
learn things as fast as
him so that I can be an
Alchemist too when I grow up!
scripts.translation:
[科林]
爸爸是怎麼變得這麼聰明的？我希望我能像他一樣快地學習，這樣我長大後也能成為鍊金術士！

scripts.text:
[Beninne]
You've met my husband,
Kellasus? He's either a
very stubborn or determined
man, depending on how you
want to look at it. Once his
mind's made up, he won't budge!
scripts.translation:
[貝妮娜]
你見過我丈夫凱拉蘇斯嗎？他要麼是一個非常固執要麼是一個非常堅定的人，這取決於你怎麼看。一旦他下定決心，他就不會動搖！

scripts.text:
[Beninne]
He's a very good husband
and father, but I feel like it
takes the entire world to
change his mind once he's 
convinced that he's right
about something.
scripts.translation:
[貝妮娜]
他是一個非常好的丈夫和父親，但一旦他認定自己是對的，我覺得就算全世界來勸也很難改變他的想法。

scripts.text:
[Beninne]
Of course, if you manage
to prove him wrong, he will
do everything he can to make
up for it. Kellasus has been
like that since I first met him.
scripts.translation:
[貝妮娜]
當然，如果你能證明他錯了，他會盡他所能來彌補。凱拉蘇斯從我第一次見到他起就是這樣的。

scripts.text:
[Beninne]
It feels so nice to
have someone like that
to be protective of you.
Kellasus loves his work,
but he loves his family even
more. Amazing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[貝妮娜]
有像他那樣保護你的人感覺真好。
凱拉蘇斯熱愛他的工作，但他更愛他的家人。
真不可思議，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Beninne]
Most people think that
being a scientist's wife
would be so difficult. I must
be lucky that my husband is
such a good family man, even
though he may be an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[貝妮娜]
大多數人覺得做科學家的妻子會很辛苦。我真的很幸運，我丈夫是個顧家的好男人，儘管他是個鍊金術士。

scripts.text:
[Nannan]
You know, I always thought that all Alchemists were bookish,
scholarly types, their faces always buried in books and studying. But
I managed to find one who doesn't fit that nerdy stereotype at all.
scripts.translation:
[南南]
你知道嗎，我一直以為所有鍊金術士都是那種書呆子，整天埋頭讀書做研究。但我發現了一個完全不符合這種刻板印象的人。

scripts.text:
[Nannan]
This guy, what's-his-face,
Broncher, is always wasting
his time drinking. I guess he discovered the secret of turning
water into Grade A booze. But at least he's not the stuffy type.
scripts.translation:
[南南]
這傢伙，叫什麼來著，布朗徹，整天就知道喝酒。我想他大概是發現了把水變成上等美酒的秘訣吧。不過至少他不是那種古板的人。

scripts.text:
[Nannan]
I don't know how much
help he'd be to an aspiring
Alchemist, but in my opinion,
the man is a fully fledged
genius! At least, compared
to a street guy like me...
scripts.translation:
[南南]
我不知道他對想成為鍊金術士的人有多大幫助，但在我看來，他絕對是個天才！至少，比起我這種街頭混混來說...

scripts.text:
[Alchemist]
Out of all humans,
I believe Kellasus is
the one who has come
closest to discovering
the secrets of life. He
never fails to amaze me...
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士]
在所有人中，我認為凱拉蘇斯是最接近揭開生命奧秘的人。他總是能讓我感到驚歎...

scripts.text:
[Alchemist]
I'm also impressed by the
fact that he doesn't let his
work keep him from being the
best father and husband that
he can for his family. He's
an example for all of us.
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士]
我也很佩服他，他沒有讓工作妨礙他成為家人眼中最好的父親和丈夫。他是我們所有人的榜樣。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist]
Kellasus really is
an amazing person.
There isn't one Alchemist
that I know who doesn't look
up to him in the realms of
both science and personal life.
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士]
凱拉蘇斯真的是個了不起的人。據我所知，沒有哪個鍊金術士不在科學和個人生活方面都敬仰他。
